en.headline: Sources say first national security law convict and three others released early
en.dek: Reports citing sources said Leon Tong Ying-kit, former Apple Daily publisher Cheung Kim-hung, Wayland Chan and Andy Li were granted early release after high-profile convictions.
body: Sources told the South China Morning Post on Monday that the first person convicted under Hong Kong's national security law, Leon Tong Ying-kit, and three others in related cases had been released early.

Tong was sentenced in 2021 to nine years for inciting secession and terrorist activities. The reports also named former Apple Daily publisher Cheung Kim-hung, Wayland Chan and Andy Li as having been released ahead of their original terms. Dimsum Daily separately reported similar information regarding the Apple Daily-related cases.

Under rules tightened after the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, the Commissioner of Correctional Services must be satisfied that early release would not be contrary to national security. The reports attributed the information to sources and did not include official confirmation from the Correctional Services Department.

zh.headline: 消息指首名國安法定罪者及三人獲提早釋放
zh.dek: 報道引述消息指唐英傑、前蘋果日報出版人張劍虹、陳梓華及李宇軒在高調定罪後獲提早釋放。
body: 《南華早報》周一引述消息指，香港國安法首名被定罪者唐英傑，以及另外三人在相關案件中已獲提早釋放。
唐英傑於2021年因煽動分裂國家及恐怖活動被判囚九年。報道亦提及前蘋果日報出版人張劍虹、陳梓華及李宇軒獲提前釋放。點心日報亦有類似報道。
根據《維護國家安全條例》收緊後的規則，懲教署署長須信納提早釋放不會危害國家安全。報道將資料歸因於消息人士，並未包括懲教署的官方確認。
